label: Texture
description: The concrete sensory and material grain of the page, for the whole book or one part of it: which senses lead, how much detail the page carries, what recurs and which motifs gather meaning. Sentence mechanics and the description of one place belong to other kinds.

fields.label: Leading senses
fields.help: Which senses the page leans on most across the span this texture covers, in rough order of weight.

fields.label: Span covered
fields.help: How much of the book this texture applies to, so that a texture for one part can be read against the book-wide one.

fields.label: Material palette
fields.help: The broad classes of material, goods, food, clothing and everyday technology that furnish the page and fix its period and station, one class per item.

fields.label: Density of detail
fields.help: How much concrete detail a typical page carries, from only what the action needs to every surface furnished.

scaleLabels.low: Sparse: only what the scene needs

fields.label: Precision of detail
fields.help: How exactly concrete things are rendered on the page, from broad impressions to precise, named and measured particulars.

fields.label: Where detail thickens or thins
fields.help: The scenes or moments where concrete detail deliberately rises above or falls below the usual density, and why, one per item.

fields.label: Senses held back
fields.help: Senses or kinds of detail the page deliberately keeps scarce or withholds, and what that restraint is for, one per item.

fields.label: What earns a detail its place
fields.help: The main test a concrete detail must pass before it goes on the page.

options.label: The viewpoint character would notice it
It makes the world feel solid
It reveals the people in the scene
It sets up a later payoff
The test changes from scene to scene

fields.label: Recurring details
fields.help: Concrete objects, sounds, smells, habits or materials that come back across the span, one per item, in the order a reader first meets them.

fields.label: Motifs
fields.help: Repeated images or patterns that gather meaning each time they return, one per item, each named by its concrete form.

fields.label: How openly the motifs show
fields.help: How far the motifs announce themselves to a reader, from passing unnoticed on a first read to being plainly signalled.

scaleLabels.low: Barely noticed on a first read

fields.label: How the motifs develop
fields.help: How each motif changes in form or meaning across its returns, and where its last appearance leaves it.

fields.label: Texture risks
fields.help: Ways the concrete detail could misfire for a reader, such as clutter, stock images, anachronism or numbing repetition, one per item.
